_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: delta -60.00, entirely STRUCTURAL. This is a split50 sheet, which itemizes only donors giving MORE than $50; the single itemized row ($270.00) reproduces the printed '>$50' box to the cent, and the printed '<=$50' box is $60.00 - an aggregate the form does not require to be itemized. The module's stated 330.00 is the sum of BOTH boxes (270.00 + 60.00), so the residual IS that aggregate and no row is missing from the page. The one row is ALSO an in-kind ('In Kind from Park City Board of Realtors'): it is written inline in the itemized contribution schedule and is counted inside the '>$50' box, and this 2018 form variant prints no separate in-kind schedule and no separate in-kind total, so the row is deliberately NOT flagged in_kind=True (flagging it would drop itemized_contrib_sum to 0.00 and turn a structural 60.00 residual into a fictitious 330.00 one).

expenditures.detail: exact to the cent against the module's stated cover figure across 14 rows. FILER ARITHMETIC on the page: the sheet's own boxed 'Total amount of expenditures' reads $957.33, which is 1,031.13 - 73.80, i.e. exactly the first row (9/14/18 Uprint, Stickers, $73.80) left out of the filer's box addition. Both figures are named here; the box is not recomputed and the rows are not adjusted. The cover total, which the county publishes, agrees with the rows.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT (split50): boxed '>$50' total $270.00 and boxed '<=$50' total $60.00; the single ledger row is $270.00 and reproduces the '>$50' box to the cent. p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT: the boxed 'Total amount of expenditures' reads $957.33 and is REPEATED in the amount column further down the sheet, but the 14 printed rows sum to $1,031.13 - which is exactly the module's stated cover expenditure figure. The 73.80 difference is precisely row 1 (Uprint, stickers), i.e. the filer's box omits its own first line. Arithmetic outranks the box: the rows close on the cover.

_meta_itemized.notes: Typed sheets on the narrow-ruled 2018 Summit form (83 detected row bands on p2, 80 on p3 - the printed grid, not data). No template specimen rows. The embedded OCR layer is heavily garbled on this scan (amounts read as 's73 8(' etc.), so every figure comes from the full-page image read plus two TIGHT COLUMN CROPS at 1200 dpi over p3's name and amount columns (the 2 escalations counted here). p3 line 3's vendor cell CLIPS at the column rule mid-word - the page prints 'Standard Restaurant Suppl' with the final letter cut by the vertical rule; transcribed as printed, not completed. p3 also carries a stray '9' typed alone in the Person column of an otherwise empty row about two-thirds down the grid - no date, no purpose, no amount, so it is not a transaction and is not transcribed. Mailing address and zip are printed by the FILER on p2 and are discarded at read time under the privacy rule (no county redaction on this filing). COVER-SIDE, already handled and not touched here: this filing's cover has no signature date. NOTE for the pair: the Post-Election sibling 8397 is a COVER-ONLY one-page filing with no schedule pages at all.
